RecordThing.Description: Toggles whether owned objects can take damage or be deconstructed. Server administrators may affect any object. Off affects only the target; On affects the connected construction.
Administrative tool that assigns structure ownership from an online player name or numeric Steam ID written on the gun. Off affects only the target; On affects the connected construction.
Insert into Sensor Lenses to display protected structures in red and destructible structures in green within 50 metres.
